question_text: A design team must choose between CPU-heavy and GPU-heavy hardware for a parallel image-analysis workload. Identify three hardware characteristics that help distinguish the choices.
adaptation_rationale: General computer-type comparison is narrowed to the explicitly examinable CPU/GPU design comparison; no unsupported device taxonomy.
solution: Core number and architecture/parallel execution design.; Processing throughput for the workload.; Memory access/bandwidth or power efficiency.

marking_points.criterion: Core number and architecture/parallel execution design.

acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent technically correct wording or valid implementation earning the specified independent points.
partial_credit_notes: Award each stated point independently up to the total; do not double-credit the same idea.

verification.technical: Concrete marking points independently reasoned from the defined context and exact 2027 scope.
verification.code_check: No executable code required; manual technical check.
